# Practice mode's test list (docs/plans/v2-practice-mode.md): names that each exercise one
# rule of the check, for the browser tests' hint cases (CASES in
# server/scripts/build_practice_lists.py). Nothing here is a chemistry value.
title: Test list
# The name states R/S: the whole key counts.
(R)-butan-2-ol
# No E/Z in the name: either geometry is right.
pent-2-ene
# A stereocentre the name doesn't state.
hex-1-yn-3-ol
# Relative stereo only: either enantiomer is right.
trans-1,2-dimethylcyclohexane
# An acid, for its anion.
4-hydroxybenzoic acid
# For isomers, other formulas, extra structures, reactions and generic atoms.
3-methylbutanal
# For a carbon with five bonds.
2,2-dimethylpropane
